correctness.rationale: The two length-eleven morphism images differ only at residue five. Replacing every occurrence of that residue by an independent arbitrary bit produces a stronger local condition than the actual Thue-Morse image. Exhausting all source residues and all 121 ordered shift-residue pairs leaves exactly twenty orientations of ten unordered pairs, proving the pseudoperiod property for every integer lift. The independent power-freeness proof handles nonzero period residues by a fixed-template mismatch, periods divisible by eleven by reduction to a cube in Thue-Morse, and periods one through four by exhaustive local factors. The packaged verifier reconstructs every finite ingredient from the morphism.
